description: This file contains storage-related functions for managing execution records in a database, including creating, retrieving, updating, querying, and analyzing execution data within a workflow system.

classes.name: execDepthInfo
classes.description: Helper struct for calculating maximum depth of execution DAGs based on parent-child relationships.

methods.name: scanExecution
methods.description: Scans a database row or result into a types.Execution object, handling various timestamp and payload fields.

methods.name: assignTimeValue
methods.description: Parses and assigns a timestamp value from database representations to a time.Time pointer.

methods.name: parseDBTime
methods.description: Normalizes different database timestamp formats into a time.Time object.

methods.name: parseTimeString
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string timestamp into a time.Time object using multiple layouts.

methods.name: computeMaxDepth
methods.description: Calculates the maximum depth of a DAG of executions based on parent-child relationships.
